body:
Dear friend,

You asked me so many good questions about the old map: about the sea, the ships, the far places.

I know the very person to ask: Captain Mara, at the coast! Why not write to her? A good question is the beginning of wisdom.
summary: Write a letter to Captain Mara about the sea.
done: Your letter is on its way to the coast!

tasks.where: at the table by your door
at the coop by your house
